in_marathi.name: Mahadevanand
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Gods
in_marathi.long_meaning: Mahadevanand हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Mahadevanand is a name derived from Sanskrit language. It is a compound name composed of Maha (great) and Devanand (Lord of Gods). This name is widely used in Hindu culture and mythology, denoting the supreme god in Hinduism. The name Mahadevanand is believed to bring wisdom, courage, and strength.
